capabilities: Pull content from IPFS by CID or DAG
Run compute jobs (cowsay, Stable Diffusion) through smart contracts
Splay IPFS DAG child CIDs into canvas nodes
extras: Must be built from source (clone repo, npm install, run docker compose); documentation links and tutorial videos live outside the README; several features are listed only as future plans; the blockchain commands run on a testnet.
motivation: The author states that 'The science tech stacks is due for an upgrade' and wants to enable collaboration in the decentralized science ecosystem inside Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to interact with IPFS content, decentralized science nodes, or blockchain-executed compute jobs.

relations.evidence: runSDXL - run stable diffusion by executing a transation through lilypad
Run an IPFS Daemon in the background, set the gateway default here to use IPFS

requires.name: Ethereum private key with LILETH on the lalechuza testnet
IPFS daemon (Kubo) and docker gateway API

summary: Web3 toolkit that pulls content from IPFS, fetches DeSci nodes, and runs compute jobs like Stable Diffusion via smart contracts on canvas nodes.
